question: (i) Which electromagnetic radiation lies just beyond the red end of the visible spectrum? (ii) Which radiation lies just beyond the violet end? (iii) Compare their frequencies.

options.A:
(i) Ultraviolet radiation lies beyond the red end.
(ii) Infrared radiation lies beyond the violet end.
(iii) Infrared has higher frequency than ultraviolet.
options.B:
(i) X-rays lie beyond the red end.
(ii) Gamma rays lie beyond the violet end.
(iii) Both have the same frequency.
options.C:
(i) Infrared radiation lies beyond the red end.
(ii) Ultraviolet radiation lies beyond the violet end.
(iii) Infrared has higher frequency than ultraviolet.
options.D:
(i) Infrared radiation lies just beyond the red end.
(ii) Ultraviolet radiation lies just beyond the violet end.
(iii) Ultraviolet radiation has higher frequency than infrared radiation.
